{"concern":"core","lineage":"original","name":"The implementing agent holds a compact design reference — the pseudo-design layer, derived from the graph — the way a coder holds pseudocode, and builds against it","priority":"high","provenance":"authored","statement":"Anthony, 2026-09-13, sharpening the pseudo-design brainstorm: "It isn't just a view/rendering, it is a reference for the person writing the code. What I'm getting at is some design reference that the AI agent can always refer to … a layer that the agent implementing the design can easily always reference. This is for the AI agent, not a rendered product for the human."

WHAT IS REQUIRED. reflow2 serves the pseudo-design layer of a design as ONE compact reference for the implementing agent: the requirements that must hold, every capability as a function header (name, what it takes in, what it gives out — its signature), the constraints and governed rules that must be continuously obeyed (with their units and their consequence), and every boundary the work crosses (named even where its contract is still unspecified). It is DERIVED from the graph on every read, never hand-maintained, so it cannot drift from the design the way a copied document does; it is CODE-SHAPED rather than prose; and it is SIZED to be held in context, so the agent refers to it continuously rather than fetching pieces by id. The agent building against it is the expected use, not a human reading it.

WHY THIS SHAPE, in the benefits he relayed from SudoLang's own material (claims as stated by its sources, not verified here): a structured, code-like form puts a language model in a higher-reasoning "code mode", reported as 10–15% more accurate than natural-language prompts; "referential omnipotence" — a function is inferred from its name and description without an implementation, which is exactly what a capability signature is; constraint-based programming — declare rules that are continuously obeyed rather than steps; and token efficiency — 20–30% fewer tokens than prose for the same logic. Whether those numbers hold for this reference is a measurement this project owes before claiming them (req:context-is-a-modelled-quantity was dropped precisely for asserting design-time token estimates).

WHAT ALREADY EXISTS, so this is not read as new machinery: req:intent-is-reinjected (proposed 2026-07-28, never accepted) asks that design intent be read back into a long build on a counter and on symptoms of drift, and named no payload — THIS IS ITS PAYLOAD. The capability signature setter exists (cap:a-capability-states-what-it-takes-and-gives) and is set on 3 of 247. graph_report_markdown, export_surface and the served instructions each carry part of the content. What does not exist is the one compact, agent-facing form and the instruction that the agent builds against it.

WHAT IT MUST NOT BECOME: a second hand-edited serialization that drifts from the schema; a rendering for a person (that is the SV-1/SV-4 view, a different deliverable); or a new language with a grammar — SudoLang's own claim is that models understand structured natural language with constraints unprompted, so the form is a rendering convention over the schema that already exists. Fill-ins are defects: every line traces to a node.","status":"accepted"}
